name: MS_Dos
storyline: Konichi has been trapped in a computer. However, will she get out? She'll have to navigate a world that hates her, one quite unintelligible.
summary: Imagine yourself trapped in a computer. Imagine if... maybe you are... Imagine yourself trapped in a weirdcore-inspired open-world metroidvania-style game. How would you feel? Can you feel at all? Perhaps try figuring out. In this game, you take a stroll across numerous strange worlds, listening to what people tell you, and doing as they say. Have you ever wanted to deliver milk? Have you ever wanted to serve the Milkman? Have you ever wanted to (not) kill an Angel?
